description: Five-phase averaged power stage (10-switch / 5-leg bridge): converts duties (percent, 50 = half-bus) at the DC link into phase-to-neutral-mid voltages with the IGBT knee, deadtime distortion and Rce drop, exactly the Knee3ph per-leg law extended to five legs. d_avg is the mean of all five duties, so the common-mode is removed per substep and the five phase voltages sum to the distortion residual only. Optional OpenGates floats all legs (every voltage view zeroes, twin convention). Phases A-C of the host seam come from Plant.Io.DutyIn (the 3-phase host duty node); legs D and E are declared OPTIONAL unwired inputs so the host pushes them per control period through the plant-input external (PlantSetInput / rte sim kind=plant-input, all unwired inputs of the name), same seam as InductDq.Omega_Cmd.

inputPorts.name: Da
inputPorts.description: Phase A duty, percent (0-100, 50 = zero vector contribution).

inputPorts.name: Dd
inputPorts.description: Phase D duty, percent. Optional: unwired binds 0 until assigned by the host via the plant-input external (per control period).

inputPorts.name: De
inputPorts.description: Phase E duty, percent. Optional: unwired binds 0 until assigned by the host via the plant-input external (per control period).

inputPorts.name: I_A
inputPorts.description: Phase A current, A (for sign distortion; from machine output).

inputPorts.name: OpenGates
inputPorts.description: >=0.5: power stage de-energized, all phase voltage outputs go to zero (leg nodes float; the twin's phase-ADC convention).

outputPorts.name: V_A_Raw
outputPorts.description: Pre-distortion duty-mapped phase A voltage, V (phase-ADC view: knee/deadtime/Rce error is invisible to that sensor).

Rce_Ohm.description: Effective series resistance per device path incl. lead, ohm.

TdOverhead.description: Dimensionless deadtime distortion factor: dt_dead * f_sw (e.g. 1e-6*5000 = 0.005).
